page_title: CRE 2-2 CAG | Cremonese v Cagliari 08/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) takes a shot on goal, but his effort isn't precise enough and it flies a whisker wide of the right post.
90+5' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Cagliari.
90+3' Davide Nicola decides to make a substitution. Jamie Vardy will be replaced by Antonio Sanabria (Cremonese).
90+3' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Martin Payero leaves the pitch and Alberto Grassi (Cremonese) comes on.
90+2' Relief for Sebastiano Luperto (Cagliari) as the ref reverses his original red card decision and shows a yellow instead.
90+2' Sebastiano Luperto (Cagliari) is sent off! He receives a red card and the match ends for him. He attempts to argue, but the referee's decision is final.

90+1' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Sebastiano Luperto (Cagliari), but referee Kevin Bonacina must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

88' 2 - 2 Goal! That was a fantastic finish by Yael Trepy (Cagliari) from just outside the box. He wasted little time in getting away a bullet of a shot that flew past the goalkeeper into the left side of the net.

86' What a wasted opportunity by Luca Mazzitelli (Cagliari)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the right side of the goal, but Emil Audero makes an astonishing save to thwart him.
84' The game has come to an end for Gabriele Zappa. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Yael Trepy (Cagliari).
83' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well wide of the right post.
81' Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) was probably a bit loose with his words to Kevin Bonacina, who decides to show him a yellow.
80' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Emil Audero intercepts the ball.

79' What a chance that is! Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the right post.
71' Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari) jumps highest to meet an accurate cross and heads the ball towards the net. His fine header whistles just inches over the crossbar.
70' The corner from Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) is hurriedly cleared.

69' Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The ball goes out for a corner. Cremonese can continue in their attacking effort.
67' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) has a goal ruled out for offside!
65' Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick, but it goes out of play.
65' Fabio Pisacane has decided to substitute Gianluca Gaetano and he is replaced by Semih Kilicsoy (Cagliari).
64' Jamie Vardy (Cremonese) latches on to a lofted pass and strikes the ball! His attempt flies narrowly wide of the left post.
60' We are about to witness a substitution. Alessio Zerbin (Cremonese) is replacing Giuseppe Pezzella.
60' It is time for a substitution. Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) is on for Warren Bondo.
59' Here is a change. Dennis Johnsen is going off and Davide Nicola gives the last tactical orders to Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese).
57' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
56' Fabio Pisacane has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Adam Obert (Cagliari) replacing Zito Luvumbo.
56' Substitution. Matteo Prati walks off the pitch and Luca Mazzitelli (Cagliari) comes on as a substitute.
56' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) creates a yard of space for himself and tries an effort from the edge of the box, but it goes just wide of the left post.
51' 2 - 1 Michel Adopo (Cagliari) scores! He latches on to a pass and produces a perfect strike from the edge of the box. The ball goes into the bottom right corner and past the goalkeeper.
48' Dennis Johnsen (Cremonese) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and produces a ferocious strike towards the left post, but his shot is well held by the goalkeeper.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Fabio Pisacane gives a chance to Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) and Yerry Mina is off.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+1' The end of the first half.
45+1' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the left post.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
43' A header by Juan Rodriguez (Cagliari) from very close range goes towards the left-hand post, but doesn't get past Emil Audero, who makes a brilliant save.
40' Cagliari quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
37' The opposition back off Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) and he lashes in a shot from the edge of the box that just flies a whisker wide of the left post. Unlucky!
32' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
31' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the left side of the goal, but Emil Audero is well positioned to make a comfortable save.

29' 2 - 0 What a brilliant goal by Jamie Vardy (Cremonese)! He collected a well-executed pass that had put him one-on-one with the goalkeeper. He took the goal-scoring opportunity with a shot to the middle of the goal past the keeper.
28' Jamie Vardy (Cremonese) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
26' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Emil Audero, who smothers the ball.
22' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
18' The ball falls to Jamie Vardy (Cremonese), but his shot towards the middle of the goal is weak and Elia Caprile makes an easy save.
16' Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari) climbs high to connect with a perfect cross and sends his header just over the bar.
16' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Cagliari will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
16' A cross from Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
12' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Cagliari, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
11' Warren Bondo (Cremonese) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
10' Federico Baschirotto (Cremonese) finds enough space to climb high and plants a header way over the bar. What a poor effort.
10' Cremonese have a corner.
10' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Giuseppe Pezzella (Cremonese).
4' 1 - 0 Goal! Dennis Johnsen (Cremonese) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 1:0.
4' Jamie Vardy (Cremonese) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
3' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) creates himself some space on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot which is blocked by a defender.
2' Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari) has tested the patience of referee Kevin Bonacina and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Cagliari will take the kick-off.
Kevin Bonacina will officiate today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
